state_fields.name: ACTOR_RENDER_X_OFFSET
state_fields.operation: added to each eligible actor's computed X coordinate

state_fields.name: ACTOR_RENDER_Y_OFFSET
state_fields.operation: subtracted from each eligible actor's computed Y coordinate

behavior: The level camera callbacks publish camera-resource deltas into the two signed render offsets. Render_BuildActorRecords consumes them when converting actor world positions into screen-space sprite records.
